question: Which replay policy should become canonical for stale or corrupted Responses encrypted reasoning across Copilot and non-Copilot providers?
rationale: The bug is established, but choosing between provider-specific cold sanitation, generic reactive recovery, and persisted transcript repair determines reasoning continuity, compaction safety, and ownership of durable-state migration.

options.title: Combine prevention and bounded recovery
options.body: Use provider-owned cold-history sanitation plus one generic pre-output retry for recognized encrypted-reasoning failures, leaving durable transcript rewriting to a separately approved doctor repair.

options.title: Limit the fix to provider adapters

options.title: Repair persisted transcripts
options.body: Strip or migrate encrypted reasoning in stored sessions, accepting the larger state-migration and reasoning-continuity implications.
